## Added

- Added a "Run at startup" option to General Settings. It uses the same setting as the tray menu entry and both stay in sync immediately.
- Added a "Rename" action to the icon menu, with a dialog that selects the current name, saves with Enter and cancels with Esc.
- Added an update notification window shown about 10 seconds after launch when a newer version exists. It shows the installed and available versions and offers Update, Remind me later and View changelog.

## Changes

- Removed the creator panel and its "Show creator panel" tray menu entry.
- Removed the file path tooltip that appeared when hovering over an icon.

## Improvements

- Improved icons: shortcuts now show the icon of their target, without the shortcut arrow, including Microsoft Store apps.
- Improved icon labels so a word that fits on the next line moves there as a whole instead of being split.
- Improved General Settings so all options stay reachable by scrolling.

## Download

Windows x64 Setup EXE.
